name: Maya Chen
summary: Maya enjoys creating accessible tools that help students learn.
journey: Maya studied computer science, worked on a campus accessibility project, and joined a product engineering team.
advice: Build small projects for real people and listen closely to their feedback.

name: Jordan Rivera
summary: Jordan studies how local ecosystems respond to environmental changes.
journey: Fieldwork as an undergraduate led Jordan to environmental monitoring.
advice: Volunteer on research projects to discover which problems motivate you.

name: Avery Patel
summary: Avery helps teams make digital experiences easier to use.
journey: A psychology course introduced Avery to user research and product design.
advice: Show your process, not just your final design.

name: Noah Williams
summary: Noah uses data to help organizations answer practical questions.
journey: Statistics projects opened the door to an internship analyzing customer feedback.
advice: Practice communicating what the numbers actually mean.

name: Leila Hassan
summary: Leila supports patients and families through important decisions.
journey: Leila discovered nursing through community volunteering.
advice: Talk to working professionals before choosing a specialty.

name: Elijah Brooks
summary: Elijah tells stories that connect organizations with their communities.
journey: Writing for a student newspaper led to communications internships.
advice: Keep examples of your work and ask for constructive criticism.

name: Sophia Reed
summary: Sophia helps prototype machines and test designs.
journey: A robotics club inspired Sophia to study engineering and manufacturing.
advice: Be curious about how everyday objects work.

name: Owen Kim
summary: Owen designs lessons to help students find their voices.
journey: Tutoring in college convinced Owen to pursue classroom teaching.
advice: Spend time in a classroom before deciding on a teaching path.
